profile.name: Rohit P. Chavan
profile.headline: BSc Data Science student passionate about turning data into insights.
profile.bioSummary: Raw data doesn't tell you much on its own. I do the work in between cleaning it, finding what matters, and presenting it in a way that drives real decisions. I use Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Excel across the whole pipeline: from messy spreadsheets to finished dashboards.
profile.longBio: I'm a MCA student at Institute of Management Research and Development, Shirpur, building expertise in Python, data analysis, and statistical modeling. I enjoy transforming raw data into clear, actionable insights and developing AI-driven solutions to real-world problems. With certifications in Python and IT, along with a track record of hands-on projects, I aim to contribute wherever data and technology can make a difference.
